summary.name: Nani Translate
summary.one_liner: Nani is an AI translation tool with web and desktop versions that also helps with writing, proofreading, and explanations across languages.
use_cases: Translating text in any desktop app via a shortcut
Getting translation explanations and example sentences
Translating sensitive or explicit text that standard models refuse
summary.what_it_does: Nani is a web app and desktop app for translating text between over 100 languages. The desktop app on macOS and Windows lets you translate or proofread selected text from any application using a shortcut. Translation history is stored on the device for the desktop app, while the web version keeps history only temporarily. The page says Nani sends content to external AI services, mainly OpenAI and Google models, and that a sensitive model can handle content the standard models may refuse. Nani also offers a naniapp:// URL scheme on Mac and Windows for opening translations from other apps or automation tools.
notable: Desktop shortcut to translate or proofread selected text in any app
Translation history stored on device rather than Nani's servers
Sensitive model for content standard models may refuse
caveats: Desktop app requires macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon, or Windows; no Linux app yet
Free plan has limits on usage count and text length; higher limits and advanced models need a paid plan
Screenshot translation requires Pro or Team; PDF translation is planned but not yet available
No public API is currently offered
